standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
register: essay_rooms — the eight section rooms; this ONE grammar is shared by all eight room journeys (that repetition is the family grammar)

grammar.artifact_shape: one journey per room, six scenes, scene ids = global movement numbers (movement-01 … movement-48); scene order is the reading order
grammar.positional_form: the raw station-internal chassis carries a fixed formation grammar: #0 → disc (ground opens), #1 → text glyph (determinate mark), #2 → triangle (force/polarity), #3 → yantra (pattern), #4 → square (contextual 360° holding), #5 and #5→0 → ring (return)
grammar.chassis_tokens: text-glyph scenes carry the raw chassis token (#1, #3) as the formation glyph; station-internal structure is the canonical raw chassis with locally derived meanings, so the token itself is the canonical mark
grammar.text_layers: layer 1 editorial: kicker 'MOVEMENT NN OF 48 · <station> · <position> · ROOM <slug>', title (canonical movement title with chassis prefix, exactly as authored), italic (claim_status verbatim from the movement frontmatter), body (the movement's own claim line + previous/next carriers with exact titles; M48 carries the Return to M01); layer 2 route: 'P1-MNN → …' the canonical A/C route from the room's authored P1-CANONICAL-ALIGNMENT, as data (routes reference the A/A′/C records; the records are never restaged here)
grammar.layout_rule: E0 acceptance repair: formations sit right-of-centre (single-formation group centre +0.2, station scenes +0.3) so the editorial text column owns the left; oversized formations trimmed (ring 1.7→1.55, Ø 1.7×2.1→1.5×1.9, instrument rings 2.25→1.75, commons/field rings lowered/trimmed); text column 360 (320 on the two inverse-pair scenes); route/metadata layers stacked top-left (route y 0.05, room door y 0.155) — verified clear at authored count on covers and spot-checked scenes
